t: You're on Lombard Street, a street in the City of London long known for merchants, banking and insurance, with roots stretching back to medieval times. People have lived and worked here for centuries. The banker Silvanus Bevan was born on this street. Agnes Bulmer, a poet, lived here, and her epic Messiah's Kingdom, which took over nine years to write, is thought to be the longest epic poem by a woman. A wine cooper, Gerrard Roberts, and a linen draper, Nathaniel Bland, also lived here, ordinary City tradespeople of the seventeenth century.
